dataset.name: Processed Schedule B itemized disbursements
dataset.description: One processed Schedule B relation row per sender-reported disbursement observation in a weekly all-history PostgreSQL snapshot partitioned by two-year transaction period.

acquisition.pagination: None. One PostgreSQL custom-format artifact contains the parent relation and inherited two-year partitions from 1975 through the current period.

partitions.name: publisher_snapshot
partitions.source: Exact HTTP object identity, retrieval time, artifact digest, and PostgreSQL archive catalog.

partitions.name: two_year_transaction_period
partitions.source: Inherited relation selection plus the nullable row-level two_year_transaction_period field.
partitions.purpose: Physical target-cycle selection without replacing disbursement, communication, report, or processing time.

acquisition.retry_policy: Bound transport retries; pin ETag or version identity; publish only after exact byte count and digest, complete archive inventory, exact relation schema, one COPY section, row conservation, and all-row parser validity.

physical_schema.line_ending: PostgreSQL COPY text data rows use LF and require a final LF.
physical_schema.empty_record_policy: An empty physical COPY row is an explicit width issue; it is never skipped.
physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve PostgreSQL COPY \N as null and preserve empty text, zero, negative values, missing dates, and conflicting recipient IDs as distinct source values.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: 81 ordered fields pinned by fixtures/archive/dump-2026-08-30.json; sub_id and filing_form are the only NOT NULL columns; numeric precision, timestamps, search-vector text, pg_date default, and partition inheritance are preserved.

identity.occurrence_locator: artifact SHA-256 + exact inherited relation name + one-based physical COPY row ordinal
identity.record_version: occurrence locator + null-aware semantic digest of all 81 decoded relation values
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every physical occurrence. A repeated sub_id in one partition is a blocking primary-key conflict; tran_id, orig_sub_id, and content equality never collapse rows.

time_fields.meaning: Legal Tender observation time for the exact weekly dump object.
Disbursement date asserted by the sending filer; nullable and independent from communication and filing times.
Communication date asserted by the filing; nullable and not a substitute for disbursement date.
Report year retained independently from the transaction period.
Publisher-assigned two-year physical partition and query dimension; not the only temporal identity.

money_fields.meaning: Signed exact reported amount for this sender-side observation; source scale is two decimal places.
Nullable signed refund value for bundled-contribution disclosure; it is not another generic disbursement amount.

code_fields.meaning: Raw Schedule B disbursement transaction type; a separate calculation defines any flow role.
Raw processed action code; source ingestion does not decide effective status.
Raw memo code; source ingestion does not discard memo rows.
Raw recipient or payee entity type.
Raw refund or disposal of excess contribution indicator.

rules: Preserve all 81 fields before classifying effective disbursements, committee transfers, refunds, candidate-directed context, or reconciliation candidates.
Treat cmte_id as the reporting sender and preserve recipient_cmte_id and clean_recipient_cmte_id independently; neither name nor entity type can manufacture a recipient committee identity.
Keep disbursement date and communication date independent and preserve exact signed cents.
Do not discard memo rows, null amounts, null dates, negative rows, repeated transaction IDs, non-A action states, or one-sided recipient IDs during ingestion.
Do not infer that action A is effective or that another action is ineffective at the source boundary.
Do not add a Schedule B amount to a Schedule A amount solely because both describe compatible endpoints, dates, or values.
Classic oth and pas2 remain separately identified comparison and candidate-context evidence and never patch or duplicate this sender ledger.

revisions.publisher_model: The FEC replaces one weekly all-history processed snapshot. Rows expose action_cd, tran_id, back_ref_tran_id, file_num, orig_sub_id, and sub_id, but the source contract does not infer an amendment chain.
revisions.effective_projection: A later versioned calculation must classify sender-side flow roles and effective observations, then a separate reconciliation must connect compatible Schedule B and Schedule A assertions without double counting.

checks.rule: Final URL, HTTP validators, byte count, retrieval time, and complete dump SHA-256 are recorded.
pg_restore inventories exactly the parent plus inherited partitions and every selected relation exposes exactly the 81 contracted columns in order with compatible types and nullability.
Each selected relation emits exactly one COPY section and its row count, byte count, and SHA-256 are conserved.
Every row is LF-terminated UTF-8 PostgreSQL COPY text with exactly 81 fields and valid null and escape syntax.
Required values, NUMERIC precision and scale, integer precision, and timestamp syntax validate without binary floating point or silent coercion.
Every row has a positive decimal sub_id and no duplicate key within one partition.
A complete target-cycle scan measures exact sub_id membership against same-period oth and pas2 without adding their amounts.
A same-release target-cycle comparison measures compatible sender/receiver direction and reconciliation candidates before authority is accepted.

A complete selected-cycle publication preserves every valid source row and all 81 lexemes, proves global sub_id uniqueness, round-trips the 98-column Parquet schema, and replays idempotently before authority is accepted.
This source contract never defines an effective outgoing-flow total by itself; a separate calculation contract must classify every source occurrence exactly once.

use.retention: Retain each accepted dump object, HTTP metadata, archive catalog, exact relation extract identity, occurrence versions, and issues indefinitely. Selected-cycle facts and calculations are rebuildable.
use.disclaimer: Processed Schedule B rows are sender-filed disbursement assertions. Amendments, memo records, action states, refunds, dates, recipient identities, and source anomalies affect effective totals; a compatible Schedule A receipt is corroborating or conflicting evidence, not another payment.
